nodes.label: pnpm run build:msix (MSIX packaging)
nodes.rationale: Builds the launcher with Tauri then packages the resulting binary as a .msix for Microsoft Store distribution; requires makeappx.exe from the Windows SDK. -SkipBuild option lets the already-compiled binary be reused instead of rebuilding.

nodes.label: pnpm run version:set (version sync script)
nodes.rationale: Synchronizes the version string across package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, and src-tauri/Cargo.toml so all three stay consistent when bumping the app version.

nodes.label: OLD/ folder (legacy Electron launcher)
nodes.rationale: The previous Electron-based version of the launcher is kept in the OLD/ directory purely as a reference during/after the migration to Tauri 2.

nodes.label: Recommended IDE Setup: VS Code + Tauri extension + rust-analyzer
nodes.norm_label: recommended ide setup: vs code + tauri extension + rust-analyzer

nodes.label: esbuild allowBuilds setting
nodes.rationale: Explicitly allows esbuild's postinstall build script to run under pnpm, since pnpm blocks arbitrary lifecycle scripts by default for security; esbuild is trusted here as a dependency (likely pulled in via Vite).
